medida_sesion_nota: In memory only: erased when ZERO closes. Isolated tabs and mandate tabs are not included.
medida_nota_huella: A fingerprint is a set of reads that can recognise your computer without cookies: how it draws text, which graphics card it has, how it renders a sound, which fonts it has. Some websites make them for other reasons, such as drawing or games. ZERO does not change what they read: it only counts it. It looks at the main page, not the frames inside it, and the origin comes from the call stack, which the page itself can alter.
medida_nota_grabacion: A session recording service can keep what you do on the page (clicks, movements, what you type) to watch it later. ZERO sees where requests go, not what they carry: “after you typed” does not mean it took what you typed.
medida_nota_cifrado: ZERO recognises the parameter's name and the value's shape (a SHA-256 or MD5 hash); it does not keep the value or know whose it is. Hashed does not mean anonymous: the same email always gives the same hash, and it can be used to recognise you.
medida_nota_subida: Counts the body of requests (what is sent besides the address). When the browser cannot read it, the request counts without a size. What travels in the address itself is not added.
motivo_peligro: danger: malware, scam or phishing (URLhaus and uBlock Origin)

medida_nota_ruido: With maximum protection, ZERO gives scripts of other companies a different fingerprint: the canvas and the audio with a tiny change, always the same on this website while ZERO stays open, and a generic graphics card. The website itself and its same owner are never touched, nor a small canvas or one without text. “We gave it a different one” is only said when something really changed.

cortes_dice_nota: On your screen only: ZERO decodes it in your PC's memory to show you and forgets it when it closes. GUARDIANA does not keep it, does not see it, and it never leaves your PC unless you download it. Passwords, keys and session cookies are never shown: they are no use to ask for deletion and would give access to your accounts.
cortes_dice_ids: These are the identifiers {empresa} knows you by: you can cite them so it deletes what it holds about you.
dice_ya_no: That data is no longer in memory: ZERO forgets it when it closes.
dice_archivo_cabecera:
Data your browser was about to send to {empresa} ({destino}) on {fecha}, which GUARDIANA ZERO cut before it left.
ZERO decoded it on your PC; GUARDIANA neither keeps nor sees it. This file is yours.
dice_archivo_ids: Identifiers it knows you by (cite them when you ask for your data to be deleted):
cortes_dice_hash_explica: GUARDIANA did not make this code: it is your e-mail (or phone) as the website sends it to {empresa}, turned into a code (SHA-256). That way {empresa} matches it with your account without it being readable at a glance. The code cannot be undone, but it can be checked: type your e-mail or phone and ZERO tells you right here whether it is yours. What you type does not leave this screen.
cortes_dice_hash_si: Yes, it is yours: {empresa} was receiving «{dato}» disguised as a code (field {campo}).
cortes_dice_hash_no: It does not match «{dato}». Try another e-mail or phone of yours.

auditoria_nota: These are the page's attempts, cut by ZERO or not, to companies the open lists class as tracking, advertising or data brokers. Asking for them before your answer does not by itself prove a breach: it depends on what they are used for.

recibo_privacidad_nota: Every request in this list was cut by GUARDIANA ZERO before it left the browser. «campos» are the names of what it carried, never their values; «lleva» is their meaning, as the company documents it or by the usual name of the field. This receipt does not see other applications on the computer, isolated tabs, what each website's servers send on their own, or what each company does with what it gets. The signature proves the receipt was not changed after this browser wrote it.
recibo_privacidad_guardado: Signed receipt saved to {ruta}. Check it at guardianagroup.com/verificar; this computer's key fingerprint is {huella}.
cortes_servidor_explica: Nobody publishes who owns this name. Its server is in {pais}, on the network of {red}, according to the DB-IP base inside the program (its address is not kept).
cortes_servidor_explica_sin_red: Nobody publishes who owns this name. Its server is in {pais}, according to the DB-IP base inside the program (its address is not kept).
cortes_servidor_anycast_explica: Nobody publishes who owns this name. Its server is on the network of {red}, which serves the same address from many countries at once: so it has no single country.
cortes_sin_pais_nota: When the company is not known, the country is its server's («Server in…»), according to the DB-IP base inside the program. «Server spread around the world»: the same address is served from many countries at once. «Seat not published» and «Owner not identified» remain only while the server is being looked up or if it could not be found: putting a country there would be inventing it.
cortes_recibo_titulo: Saves a file with everything that was cut, sealed so nobody can change it without it showing
cortes_recibo_explica: «Signed receipt (proof)» saves to your Downloads a file with every request ZERO cut in this period: the time, the page, the company, its country and what it carried. ZERO seals it with a key that only exists in this browser, like the wax seal on an envelope: if anyone changes a single letter, the seal no longer fits. It works as proof for a lawyer, an authority or a journalist, and anyone can check it at guardianagroup.com/verificar without installing anything.
sec_frase_v1: Messages, files and calls encrypted end to end between two computers. Nobody in between can read anything: not even GUARDIANA.
sec_c_recibir_texto: This computer waits for the other one to call. GUARDIANA opens the door in your router by itself and gives you a code so they can call you.
sec_c_llamar_texto: Paste the code the other person gave you (or their address:port if you are on the same network). It is not kept.
sec_s_texto: You both see three numbers. Say them aloud or in person. If they match, the identity is verified and pinned; if not, someone is in the middle.
sec_tarjeta_mala: The other computer’s card is not properly signed. Stopping.
sec_sas_no: The numbers did not match. Closed without verifying.
sec_sas_fallo: The verification did not add up. Closed.
sec_err_archivo: The file could not be saved.
sec_archivo_mal: The file arrived damaged or incomplete and was discarded.
sec_en_pausa: The conversation is paused; nothing is sent.
sec_l_sin_permiso: Without permission for the microphone or camera there is no call.
sec_l_no_reproduce: This browser cannot play the call.
sec_r_nota: Signed with this computer’s key. No message contents, no file names, no addresses.
sec_c_codigo_texto: Give this code to the other person (by phone, by message). With it they can call you from anywhere. It expires when you close.
sec_c_abriendo: Opening the door in your router…
sec_c_sin_puerta: Your router did not let the door open ({e}). On your own network they can call you at port {p}; from outside, better let the other person wait and you call with their code.
sec_mv_texto: Open your phone’s camera and point it at the code. A guardianagroup.com page opens that talks directly to this computer, encrypted, with nothing to install. It works on your Wi-Fi and, with the router door open, on mobile data outside too.
sec_mv_e_espera: Waiting for you to scan the code
sec_mv_e_fuera: Phone accepted · not connected right now
sec_mv_e_habla: The conversation is on your phone
sec_mv_ok_texto: A phone just connected with this code. Is it yours?
sec_mv_habla: The call and the chat continue on your phone. This computer uses neither microphone nor camera meanwhile.
sec_mv_fuera_abriendo: Opening the router door so the phone can also come in on mobile data…
sec_mv_fuera_si: Door open: the phone can carry the conversation outside, on mobile data.
sec_mv_fuera_no: The router did not open the door ({e}): the phone works on your own Wi-Fi.
sec_mv_soltado: The phone disconnected; if it comes back, it carries on by itself.
sec_mv_error: The hand-off to the phone could not be prepared: {e}
sec_c_rele_texto: Your router would not open a door, so GUARDIANA uses its blind relay: a server that only joins the two connections and passes bytes that are already encrypted; it can read nothing and keeps no addresses. Give this code to the other person. It expires when you close.
sec_c_rele_listo: No door in the router. Waiting at the blind relay.
sec_c_rele_buscando: No door in the router. Connecting to the blind relay…
sec_e_buscando: Looking for the other person at the blind relay…
sec_rele_fallo: The relay could not be used: {e}
sec_paso_1: One of you presses «Invite» and sends the code to the other.
sec_paso_2: The other types that code under «I have a code».
sec_paso_3: You both compare three numbers and you can talk.
sec_c_invitar_texto: Press and GUARDIANA gives you a code for the other person. They type it into their GUARDIANA and you meet here.
sec_c_tengo_texto: The other person already sent you their code. Type it here.
sec_c_mensaje_invitacion:
Connect with me on GUARDIANA Communications with this code: {c}

In the program: «Communications» tab → «I have a code» → type the code → «Join». If you don’t have it yet: https://guardianagroup.com/en/install.html
sec_c_listo: Send it. As soon as they type it, you will see each other here.
sec_c_via_puerta: Path: direct between the two computers (door open in your router).
sec_c_via_rele: Path: through GUARDIANA’s blind relay (it only passes already encrypted data; it cannot read it).
